Name: Vanilla Styled Electric Mill (CP)
Author: Warilized
TagLine: Replaces the Vanilla Mill to a more good looking (at least in my opinion) mill.
Description:
Have you ever wonder why the mill looks weird in some way or another?
Have you ever though "I should hire a better carpenter to do this job"?

Well, you now can magically replace it with the power of science! Or so they said...

-------------------------------**About this mod:**
This is a Vanilla Mill texture mod. It replace the Mill to a more good looking modern Vanilla looking mill (?)
**This Mod Contains:**
This mod comes with 3 different types of Mills:

*   Type 1: Electric Mill with Fan

*   Type 2: Electric mill without Fan

*   Type 3: Taller version of Type 2
**Configurations:**

*   Enable Mod: "true/false" - Enables the mod.

*   Style: "Type #" - Mill Style.
**Installation:**

1.  Install [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400) and [Con tent Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) , or else this mod is useless.

2.  If this is your first installation, skip this step. Before placing the mod into "Mods" folder, deleting old mod file is recommended to avoid some problems.

3.  Unzip this mod paste it into "Mods" folder.

4.  Done
**Uninstallation:**

1.  Delete the mod.

2.  Done.
